capacity_usable_kwh.notes: BMW release (M70): "the battery provides 101.7 kWh of usable energy"; InsideEVs US xDrive60 same; eDrive50/M70 share the pack. 2023-2026 compared: no change named.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2023 (the page read); model years compared 2023 to 2024, nothing shows a change. InsideEVs US: 107.8 total.
Estimated: same hardware as MY2023 (the page read); model years compared 2023 to 2024, nothing shows a change. ArenaEV: 105.7 total (most listings).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2023 (the page read); model years compared 2023 to 2024, nothing shows a change. ArenaEV i7 page: 376 V nominal, "400V type" (BMW i7 pages do not state voltage).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: lineup-wide feature on BMW Gen5 EVs (BMW US i4 page: navigation-triggered; manual control not addressed); no i7 page names it.

chemistry.notes: ADAC manufacturer-data table for the i7 M70 xDrive (07/23-06/26): Nickel-Mangan-Cobalt, 105.7 kWh gross / 101.7 net, the same pack figures on file for this car. Years 2023-2026 compared; no pack change before the 2027 Gen6 pack. ADAC's xDrive60 page has no chemistry row.

dc_max_kw.notes: BMW release: DC up to 195 kW (InsideEVs: same as the iX).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware as MY2023 (the page read); model years compared 2023 to 2024, nothing shows a change. InsideEVs (US): AC up to 11 kW from a 48 A station (ArenaEV 11 kW). BMW global M70 release says 22 kW as standard (Europe).
